title: Practice 5: Object clauses: что, чтобы, ли

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Is there any way to an unperturbed mind?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существует ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is immortality a blessing or a curse?
exercises.why: **Проклятье ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (проклятие): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: I wonder if he's at home.
exercises.why: **дома ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (дом): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Can Trump be trusted?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (должный + ли) хинди преподаваться в школах во всей Индии?
exercises.prompt: Should Hindi be taught in schools across India?
exercises.why: **должный → Должен ли** — short form (masc.): no ending. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Are there benevolent djinn?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существуют ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли) я заказать звонок-будильник на семь утра?
exercises.prompt: Could you give me a wake-up call at seven?
exercises.why: **мочь → Могу ли** — present tense, 1st person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (знать + ли) вы что-нибудь о дрессировке собак?
exercises.prompt: Do you know anything about training dogs?
exercises.why: **знать → Знаете ли** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is the Pope Catholic?
exercises.why: **Католик ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (католик): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Does extraterrestrial life exist?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существует ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Are there many mice in the tundra?
exercises.why: **Много ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (много): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Do we need a universal language?
exercises.why: **нужный → Нужен ли** — short form (masc.): no ending. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Не знаю, ___ (хватить + ли) у меня нахальства на такую попытку.
exercises.prompt: I don't know whether I've got the chutzpah to try it.
exercises.why: **хватить → хватит ли** — perfective verb,  person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Was Tom a junkie?
exercises.why: **быть → Был ли** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is Egyptian still spoken?
exercises.why: **говорить → Говорят ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (можно + ли) обесцвечивать волосы во время беременности?
exercises.prompt: Is it ok to bleach hair during pregnancy?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Интересно, ___ (знать + ли) Том кодовую комбинацию к этому сейфу.
exercises.prompt: I wonder if Tom knows the combination to this safe.
exercises.why: **знать → знает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: «___ (легко + ли) учить французский?» — «Ну, он проще, чем гэльский».
exercises.prompt: "Is it easy to learn French?" "Well, it's easier than Gaelic."
exercises.why: **Легко ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (легко): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (знать + ли) вы, что Окинава ближе к Китаю, чем к Хонсю?
exercises.prompt: Are you aware that Okinawa is closer to China than to Honshu?
exercises.why: **знать → Знаете ли** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Do you consider yourself a patriot?
exercises.why: **считать → Считаете ли** — present-type form, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.
